title: Geo Value Labels
description: Optional human-readable diagnostic labels for the ISO codes in geo_countries, geo_countries_exclude, geo_regions, and geo_regions_exclude, keyed by code (e.g., { "DE": "Germany", "US-CA": "California" }). Every key MUST appear in one of those four arrays; extra keys are a conformance error. Labels are not a targeting dimension: they are non-authoritative, MUST NOT be used to resolve or apply targeting, and are ignored when comparing targeting for equality or readback. Metro and place labels live in value_labels on their own entries.

x-adcp-validation.description: Every geo_value_labels key MUST appear in at least one of the listed sibling arrays. JSON Schema draft-07 cannot express this sibling-field key membership constraint, so conformance tooling must enforce it.
